site_source: Original Native map name and reviewed non-through intersection boundary; map readback and both surveyed lane waypoint sequences are required before spawn.
devices_source: Original actor ID, type, facing ego road/lane, inactive competing authority for sign cases, live signal state or officer observation for exceptions, and source-reviewed unobligated counterpart route. A case label alone is insufficient.
routes_source: Original ego and counterpart road/lane IDs, Native waypoint transforms and vehicle blueprints. Both routes are checked against the live Native map before actors are spawned.
